spans.s: --Heaven; see also Suvarlokam; presiding deity is सूर्य, who is therefore known as Divaspati; here live Gandharvas, राक्षसस्, Apsarasas, यक्षस्, नागस्, and men; five-fold route to, from पातालम्; equal to earth in measure- ment of rotation or border.
--a son of उदारधि and Bhadra; husband of वरान्गि and father of Ripu. Br. II. ३६. १०१; वा. ६२. ८७. [page२-090+ ३३]

(II)--सूर्य, Lord of Bhavya. Br. II. २३. ५०; वा. १०१. २२.
--(दिवार्क ब्र्। प्।)--son of भानु and father of Sahadeva; leader of an army. भा. IX. १२. १०-11.

(III)--divided the earth into ten political divisions and distributed them among इक्स्वाकु and other [page२-091+ २८] cognates. Sudyumna in woman's disguise did not get any share; वसिष्ठ got him प्रतिष्टा and he in turn offered it to Pururavas. वा. ८५. २०-23.

(V)--a name of भीमरथ, king of काशि; ruined by राक्षस Ks2emaka. दिवोदास established his head- quarters at the city of Gomati on the outskirts of the state; a राजऋषि, his wife सुयशा prayed to गणपति in the temple at the city of Nikumbha for a son and as the God was not pleased to grant her prayer even after a long time, दिवोदास had the temple demolished and hence cursed; defeated and slew the १०० sons of भद्रश्रेनि except the child Durdama; through queen दृषद्वति he got a son Pratardana. वा. ९२. २३-64; Vi.
(VI)--the राजऋषि, son of बध्यश्व and Menaka. वा. ९९. २०१.
(VII)--the son of हर्यश्व and father of मित्रायु. Vi. IV. १९. ६२, ६९.
--a class of deities of the चाक्षुष epoch.

--३६० days of human reckoning ac- cording to the सावन calculation; अहस् or day is उदगायनम् and रात्रि or night is दक्षिणायनम्; मासम्, ३० years of human calculation; three months and ten days equal to १०० years of human counting; सम्वत्सर = ३६० years of human years;
--a पारावत God of the स्वरोचिष epoch. Br. II. ३६. १४.
--divine men, the ten sons of Vaivasvata Manu. M. ११. ४१.
--a son of Uttama Manu. Br. II. ३६. ३९. [page२-094+ ३०]
